mainEntity.name: What is the best private dictation app for Mac?

acceptedAnswer.text: Gojo is a strong fit when you want verified local models and direct insertion into the active Mac text field. Superwhisper suits people who want configurable formatting modes. MacWhisper is stronger for transcribing saved recordings. Apple Dictation is the simplest free option.

mainEntity.name: Does local dictation work without internet?

acceptedAnswer.text: It can, after its required model files are installed. Verify that both speech recognition and any cleanup model run locally, because some apps combine local transcription with cloud formatting.

mainEntity.name: Is a voice recorder with transcription the same as dictation?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. A recorder usually produces a transcript to review or copy later. A dictation app is designed to put text into the field where you are already writing.

blocks.text: Private dictation has four separate boundaries

content.s: A local speech model answers only the first question. You also need to know whether audio leaves the Mac, whether a cleanup model receives the raw transcript, what the app stores, and how text reaches the destination. An app can transcribe locally and still send text to a cloud language model for rewriting.

blocks.text: 1. Gojo for local dictation into the app you are using

content.s: Gojo records a push-to-talk utterance, runs the selected model on the Mac, then inserts only the final transcript into the text field that was focused when recording began. It does not save raw audio by default, log transcript text, or switch to a cloud recognizer when the local model fails. Model installation is explicit and separate from recording.

items: Local choices: Parakeet Unified, Parakeet v3, Whisper Small, and Whisper Large v3.

The current synthetic fixture measured Whisper Small at 0.55% word error rate and 354.5 ms p95 final inference latency on the documented M4 Pro test machine. This is a Gojo engineering benchmark, not a cross-vendor result.
Gojo refuses secure fields and rechecks the captured app, window, and field before insertion.

content.s: Superwhisper has the deepest mode system in this group. Its security documentation explains how to pair a local voice model with a local language model, or skip post-processing, so audio and text stay on the machine. That flexibility is useful, but it means the privacy boundary belongs to the chosen configuration rather than the app name alone.

blocks.text: 3. MacWhisper for recordings and long transcripts

content.s: MacWhisper is the obvious specialist when the source already exists as an audio or video file. Its official listing emphasizes local Whisper transcription, transcript editing, subtitles, speaker recognition, exports, and a global access window. Choose it over Gojo when the artifact is the transcript itself rather than text you want inserted into the current app.

Droppy documents a careful local pipeline with explicit Whisper or Parakeet downloads and user-controlled audio retention. Its advantage is capture: recordings can start from the Shelf, menu bar, or a shortcut, and existing audio files can enter the same pipeline. Gojo has the stronger case when your endpoint is the field already under the cursor.

blocks.text: 5. Apple Dictation for the built-in baseline

content.s: Apple Dictation is already on the Mac and can type wherever the insertion point is active. Apple tells users to check Keyboard settings to see whether their language processes general dictation on-device. That conditional wording matters. It is a good baseline for occasional use, but it does not expose Gojo's model selection, integrity checks, or insertion safeguards.

items.q: What is the best private dictation app for Mac?

a.s: Gojo is a strong fit for verified local models and direct cross-app insertion. Superwhisper is stronger for configurable modes, while MacWhisper is stronger for saved recordings.

items.q: Can Mac dictation run fully offline?

a.s: Yes, after required models are installed, if both transcription and cleanup use local models. Test the exact mode with the network disabled rather than relying on a general privacy label.

items.q: Why does Gojo need Accessibility permission?

a.s: Gojo uses Accessibility access to identify and safely insert text into the field you selected. Microphone permission covers recording. The two permissions do different jobs.
